subject: looking for some paid help to refine my Shiny App

messages.author: ce9985233c5ffc4f
messages.subject: looking for some paid help to refine my Shiny App
parts:
Shiny App Community,

I have put together a relatively simple Shiny App that I need some help refining.  99% of the app works, but I need some help making a couple improvements.


App Description:
My app is a data checking and submission app that has a sidebar and main panel. The sidebar has three tabs that do the following:
  • Tab #1 - Allows the user to upload their data in a CSV format
  • Tab #2 - Allows the user to fix their data by specifying appropriate data ranges and certain quick-fix type operations
  • Tab #3 - Allows the user to submit their data to me
The main panel is also tabbed and shows a summary of the data errors some individual tables that show specific error types.

Help Needed:
What I need help with is putting the final touches on this thing ...
  • Implement the "Submit" button that either emails me the data or places it somewhere on a server for me to pick up,
  • Implement a data loading / progress button -- I expect some of the CSV files to be in the range of 30mb and I want the user to see progress on the operation,
  • Small visual changes -- e.g. the tabs in the sidebar are white instead of grey ... guessing this can probably be done with CSS, and
  • Generally look over the web app and provide recommendations for performance improvements

Payment: USD 50-75 per hour (Elance.com, PayPal or similar)

Start date: Immediately
